T-226 is still blocked: the seat can't join a real meeting until you do one Zoom sign-in. The separate blocker list you asked for is T-407, and I checked it against production today.

- **Seat credentials:** none are saved on Live Control. The app validated earlier is "Tantra Centre", a Server-to-Server app. Zoom's meeting kit (the Meeting SDK) only runs from a "General App", so Tantra Centre can't be the seat.

- **Run sheet:** Day 1, 2 and 3 have no chat, link or poll items yet.
- **Co-hosts:** the list is empty.
- **Poll permissions:** I couldn't re-read these today, because that needs an admin sign-in. The earlier run read all 5 as missing from Zoom's token, so the list still includes them.
